observation_indicators.observable_fil: Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag ituwid, imasahe, lagyan ng di-angkop na splint, o ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury maliban kung kailangan sa kaligtasan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not straighten a deformity, massage it, use an unpadded improvised splint without training, or move a person with possible spinal injury unless safety demands it.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag. Nagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag ituwid, imasahe, lagyan ng di-angkop na splint, o ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury maliban kung kailangan sa kaligtasan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not straighten a deformity, massage it, use an unpadded improvised splint without training, or move a person with possible spinal injury unless safety demands it.
